design_summary: The user authentication module will be implemented in pure Python using a dictionary to store users and their passwords. The module will handle email validation, password strength checks, PBKDF2 hashing, HMAC-SHA256 signing, and rate-limiting.

tasks.description: Create the user authentication module with a dictionary to store users and their passwords.
Implement email validation using regular expressions.
Implement password strength checks using a combination of length, complexity, and character types.
Implement PBKDF2 hashing with a unique per-user salt of at least 16 bytes and at least 200,000 iterations.
Implement HMAC-SHA256 signing using a shared secret and include the user id and an expiry timestamp (1 hour by default).

test_strategy: Unit tests will be written for each function, including email validation, password strength checks, PBKDF2 hashing, HMAC-SHA256 signing, and rate-limiting. Integration tests will verify that the module can be used in a real-world application. Acceptance tests will validate that the module meets all the acceptance criteria.
